The second half could prove more challenging as the dividend cushion may fade and the pace of spending and income tax collections needed to meet Budget targets has to be stronger.

items.title: Govt bans export of unsorted battery waste, scrap
items.summary: The government has implemented a ban on the export of unsorted waste and scrap from certain batteries. This ban applies specifically to primary cells, batteries, and electric accumulators lacking hazardous substances. The Directorate General of Foreign Trade issued a notification establishing this prohibition, which is effective immediately. Previous regulations classified these exports as 'Free', but now they are categorized as 'Prohibited'.

items.summary: India’s depleted reservoirs are threatening agriculture and hydropower after one of the driest monsoon seasons in decades. Rabi planting has fallen behind last year, with wheat, rice and pulses acreage down.

items.title: Explainer: What is Mawan Terminal? How China’s high-tech ports could change how 80% of global trade moves
items.summary: China is expanding automated ports, including Shenzhen’s Mawan Terminal, as it seeks to lead the digital transformation of global shipping. Beijing says it has 60 automated terminals and aims for 90 by 2030.

items.title: India well on track to achieve $1 trillion exports target for FY27: Piyush Goyal
items.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India is on track to achieve its $1 trillion goods and services export target in FY27, having already recorded nearly $480 billion in exports during April-September. He highlighted opportunities from free trade agreements, particularly the proposed India-EU pact, for the automobile and mobility sectors. Goyal urged manufacturers to expand globally, boost competitiveness and leverage international partnerships to drive exports, investment and employment.

items.title: India-US hold bilateral talks in New Delhi on Customs and trade facilitation: Govt sources
items.summary: A US delegation engaged with Indian Commerce Ministry officials to enhance bilateral trade and customs procedures. The discussions took place on November 2-3 and focused on trade facilitation frameworks. Ongoing negotiations are related to the proposed Bilateral Trade Agreement aimed at improving market access. Both nations are close to finalizing an interim trade agreement, with few issues left to resolve.

items.title: Easing global headwinds, lower crude oil prices may further lift rupee in coming months: Economists
items.summary: Economists predict the Indian rupee will strengthen against the US dollar in the coming months. Factors contributing to this appreciation include lower crude oil prices and improving foreign capital inflows. Additionally, a weaker US dollar and the easing of geopolitical tensions are supporting this trend. The Reserve Bank of India has implemented measures to stabilize the currency and enhance dollar availability.

items.title: India may get a better trade deal: Samir Saran on renegotiating with the US
items.summary: Following the US midterm elections, Samir Saran emphasized India's need to navigate trade negotiations with patience. He believes aggressive US tariff threats are often part of larger negotiations rather than immediate policy changes. Saran indicated that both domestic political shifts and bipartisan support in Congress ensure continuity of US trade goals. India can leverage its vast market to secure advantageous terms during negotiations.

items.summary: The World Bank figures highlight how some smaller economies rely heavily on international trade, with cross-border flows of goods and services several times larger than their annual economic output.

items.title: India's unemployment rate falls to 5.1% in July-September as rural joblessness declines
items.summary: India's unemployment rate saw a decline to 5.1% from 5.4% in the prior quarter. The decrease in unemployment primarily occurred in rural areas, where it fell to 4.3%. The survey indicated that more individuals were either working or seeking jobs during this period. Women's employment participation also improved, rising to 34.7% from 33.2%. The overall employment figure reached approximately 57.9 crore individuals in India.

items.title: Budget 2027-28: PHDCCI urges govt to scrap LTCG tax on equities, cut STCG tax to 10%
items.summary: PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry has made recommendations for the Union Budget 2027-28. They have proposed abolishing long-term capital gains tax and reducing short-term capital gains tax rates. The chamber has also called for relaxed loan repayment norms and higher loan limits for MSMEs. They highlighted the economic significance of MSMEs in India's GDP and employment. Improved access to credit and equity support could enhance India's global manufacturing position.

items.title: India's wheat plantings seen at record high but final output to depend on weather, FAO says
items.summary: India is poised for record wheat planting this season, supported by government incentives and soil moisture. The final wheat output will depend significantly on weather patterns influenced by El Nino in April and May. El Nino typically brings above-average rainfall to key wheat-growing areas but may also increase flooding risks. Adequate snow cover from expected precipitation could benefit both overwintering crops and reservoir replenishment.

items.title: India in a 'sweet spot' amid oil volatility and currency dynamics: Kotak Neo's Anindya Banerjee
items.summary: India is in a favourable economic position due to declining crude oil prices and increasing foreign investment inflows. The Indian rupee is currently undervalued, and there is potential for appreciation if geopolitical tensions ease. Expectations suggest one more interest rate hike from both the Federal Reserve and the Reserve Bank of India. Additionally, shifting global investment sentiment is favoring markets such as India beyond artificial intelligence stocks.

items.title: Faisal Islam: What the boss of US tech giant Nvidia told me about China and national security
items.summary: Huang, who is now being investigated over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, is far more important to the future of the world order than other tech bosses.
